scope: native contract and logical ownership; no authoritative fencing, SunFS mount, concurrent SMP or physical durability qualification
runner_seed_label: 0x5b1001 is a fixed scenario label, not a PRNG input
fault_seed: none: deterministic injected tuples and explicit boundary cases
capacity: READ CAPACITY10 last+1; reject non512 and READ16 sentinel
results: BOT checks signature/tag/status/residue and exact full transfer; no partial prefix is published; byte count not retained in BlockError
typed_receipt: NOT_IMPLEMENTED: no per-command RequestId / full IoOutcome at block boundary
changes: geometry + unique boot-local incarnation; runtime errors Uncertain then permanently Unavailable
cache: USB bypasses write-back cache; readiness checked each operation
flush: SYNCHRONIZE CACHE10 implemented; no support discovery; geometry reports Unknown
ownership: xHCI uses five pinned bounce/ring frames, transfer event slot/endpoint/pointer checked, two-second TSC budget, timeout marks controller dead; generic Transport must own buffer lifetime
reset: BOT reset + clear halts for future command only; never replay WRITE; not authoritative DMA fencing
media: unit attention/removal runtime error retires this object permanently; no cross-media reopen
registry_gap: kernel USB registry still advertises WRITE|FLUSH as operations attempted; these are not qualified capability receipts
tests: existing USB BOT/SCSI tests rerun in storage.log
